stories.title: Carr, Hughes paintings sell for combined $3.5M at auction
stories.summary: Works by Victoria’s Emily Carr and E.J. Hughes, who lived in Duncan for more than 30 years, were among the top attractions at Heffel’s fall auction.

stories.title: Rafael Cabral stands tall in goal for Real Salt Lake in 4-2 penalty shootout victory over Sounders
stories.summary: SEATTLE (AP) — Rafael Cabral made saves on Seattle's first two kicks in a penalty shootout and Real Salt Lake beat the Sounders 4-2 after playing to a 1-1 draw in regulation on Thursday night in the Western Conference wild-card match.

stories.title: Berkly Catton scores a hat trick as the Kraken beat the Canucks 5-1
stories.summary: SEATTLE (AP) — Berkly Catton had his first NHL hat trick, Matty Beniers had a goal and an assist, and the Seattle Kraken snapped a three-game losing streak with a 5-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.

stories.title: Cincinnati Zoo's famed Fiona the hippo dies days after eating a visitor’s hat
stories.summary: CINCINNATI (AP) — Fiona, the hippo whose premature birth and fight for survival at the Cincinnati Zoo turned her into a global sensation nearly a decade ago, died Thursday from complications after swallowing a knit hat that was accidentally flung

stories.title: Connor McDavid's season-opening point streak ends at 23 games
stories.summary: TAMPA, Fla. (AP) — Connor McDavid accomplished something for the first time this season on Thursday — he failed to record a point.

stories.title: (Not) up in the air: Travelers' trepidations spike as Thanksgiving nears and tech hiccups abound
stories.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — At this point, it's practically as much of a Thanksgiving tradition as turkey and stuffing — crowded airports, long lines, jam-packed flights, the ever-present worry about delays and cancellations and extra expenses.

stories.title: Dozens of inmates in Romania step onto the stage for the 15th edition of a prison theater festival
stories.summary: BUCHAREST, Romania (AP) — A drama festival in Romania gave dozens of prison inmates a brief respite this week from life behind bars as they stepped into the limelight, performing on stage at a renowned theater in the capital.

stories.title: Canada's Jacobs improves to 3-0 with win over Bottcher at Grand Slam of Curling event
stories.summary: SYDNEY — Brad Jacobs continued his winning ways with a 6-3 win over Brendan Bottcher in an all-Canadian round-robin matchup in Grand Slam of Curling action on Thursday.

stories.title: Kaprizov, Hughes extend points streaks to 13 games as Wild beat Flames 4-1
stories.summary: CALGARY — Kirill Kaprizov and Quinn Hughes extended their point streaks to 13 games on Thursday to lead the Minnesota Wild to a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: U of T students take test drive of 'Grand Theft Auto VI' during launch event
stories.summary: TORONTO — Only hours after the release of "Grand Theft Auto VI," Sera Tulk sat in a University of Toronto lecture hall, playing the year's most hotly anticipated video game. "It's a lot of fun," said the fourth-year student.
